prompt.text: A coworker sends a link to a free transfer site. The company share is down, they say, and the client file has to move in the next ten minutes.

choices.label: Upload the file there
choices.debrief: The file is now on a site the company does not run, under a personal login.
choices.report: A client file went to a personal transfer site.
choices.voice_line: You put the file on a site the company does not own.

fallout.text: The link is still live. Someone outside the company opens it.

choices.label: Tell them to wait for the company share
choices.debrief: Ten minutes is not a reason to invent a new place for the file.
choices.report: The file stayed off the outside site.
choices.voice_line: You told them to wait for the company share.

choices.label: Zip it and mail it to their personal address
choices.debrief: A personal inbox is not the company share.
choices.report: The file was mailed to a personal address.
choices.voice_line: You mailed the file to a personal address.

fallout.text: The attachment is forwarded from that personal mailbox to a client who was not on the list.

draft_note: CM-8 is the inventory control for an unsanctioned service. Mark it in review if Claude wants a tighter ID.
